status: draft geometry and camera for visual review; not finished artwork
notes: Heel/toe anchors are estimated on the source boot soles, independently of ankle-to-toe rig rays. Proposed sole directions are authored from the contact/passing/recovery phases, not measured ground truth. The existing transform supplies heel travel and constant sole length; proposed directions replace inherited painted-boot angles. Support soles are placed at the ground using projected sole endpoints; other feet only move up if they would penetrate it, with six pixels of flight clearance. No whole-character bbox normalization is used. A three-dimensional boot is projected from one fixed camera; its opening determines the calf endpoint. The camera, anchors and new foot directions need review. Surface colors identify faces, not depth. No full-character depth map is claimed.
